turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's not waste the time. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski. I know your schedule is brutal.
Then answer my question, Hale. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it was entered?
I have to say, you're far more reasonable than I expected. Most parents come in swinging.
Don't manage me, Hale. I asked who decided on the zero, and I'm still waiting for an answer.
It's refreshing. You clearly see the whole picture, so I think we're really on the same side here.
Then why are we here, Hale? If we're on the same side, the zero comes off today, and you tell me who put it in before anyone called me.
